subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu: send text + multiple images as a single interactive card

question: Should Feishu text or presentation plus image attachments automatically collapse into one interactive image card, or should senders opt in with an explicit Feishu-scoped option?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but changing the default send shape is a user-visible channel behavior change and the image-card safety limits need plugin-owner intent before a fix is safe to queue.

options.title: Opt-in image cards
options.body: Add a Feishu-scoped opt-in first so existing text-plus-media sends keep sequential behavior unless the sender explicitly requests a card.

options.title: Explicit Feishu opt-in
options.body: Add a narrow Feishu send option or action parameter so existing media delivery stays unchanged unless the sender asks for a single image card.

options.title: Wait for generic presentation images
options.body: Defer the feature until the cross-channel presentation contract grows an image block instead of adding a Feishu-first send option.

recommendation.title: Opt-in image cards
recommendation.body: Add a Feishu-scoped opt-in first so existing text-plus-media sends keep sequential behavior unless the sender explicitly requests a card.

likelyOwner.reason: m1heng is the declared Feishu/Lark plugin owner and was already mentioned on this Feishu-specific product-semantics issue.
